name: Yaak
summary: The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC.

![Yaak 2026.9.0](https://yaak.app/changelog-og/2026.9.0/banner.png?v=3) The [changelog for 2026.9.0](https://yaak.app/changelog/2026.9.0) has the full write-up, with screenshots of the headline features. Here's everything that changed. ### 🎁 New • 📦 Import from Bruno ([#706](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/706), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/import-from-bruno)) • Import several files, folders, and URLs in one batch ([#706](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/706), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/support-for-importing-zip-or-multiple-files-and-only-allow-importable-file-forma)) ### 💄 Improved • 📂 Multi-file import ([#706](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/706), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/redesigned-import-data-dialog)) • Import multiple collections into one existing workspace ([#706](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/706), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/import-multiple-files-to-single-workspace)) • Show gRPC proto files and import folders as a file list ([#706](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/706), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/grpc-proto-file-picker-uses-the-shared-file-list)) • Write template string arguments in plain quotes instead of base64 ([#708](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/708)) • Convert Insomnia timestamp, hash, base64, cookie, and prompt tags on import ([#712](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/712), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/convert-the-remaining-insomnia-tags-to-native-yaak-functions-on-import)) ### 🛠️ Fixed • Keep sidebar items in place when editing items with equal sort priorities ([#705](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/705)) • Open the imported workspace after a deep-link import • 🧩 Better Insomnia imports ([#693](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/693)) • Keep template tags intact when a quoted argument contains ]} ([#710](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/710)) • Open the environment editor faster when it has many variables ([#713](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/713), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/environment-dialog-takes-about-half-a-second-to-open-on-large-workspaces)) • Select new sub-environments in the editor and keep disabled rows through bulk edit ([#714](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/714)) • Show an error instead of deleting requests when a sync file can't be read ([#725](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/725)) • Fix PDF previews on older versions of macOS ([#730](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/730), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/view-pdf-bug)) • Ignore leading and trailing spaces in request URLs ([#724](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/724)) • Return attribute and text values from XPath queries ([#723](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/723))

Here's everything that changed. ### 🎁 New • 🔄 Import into existing workspaces ([#618](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/618), ([#628](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/628), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/native-support-for-http-digest-authentication)) • Show a home screen on new installs and after deleting the last workspace ([#660](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/660)) ### 💄 Improved • 🐧 Official Arch Linux package ([feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/add-arch-linux-install-instructions-for-official-package)) • Faster search match counting in large responses ([#612](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/612), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/improve-search-performance-for-large-responses)) • Open windows without waiting for the plugin [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/visible-feedback-for-information-section)) • Import Digest, NTLM, OAuth 1.0, and folder auth from Postman collections ([#667](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/667)) • Convert Postman dynamic variables to template functions on import ([#680](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/680)) ### 🛠️ Fixed • ⚡ More responsive under load ([#642](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/642), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/lately-yaak-has-been-extremely-unstable-for-me-ive-encountered-two-issues-multip)) • Disable macOS Writing Tools suggestions inside editors • Disable Writing Tools suggestions in plain inputs ([#646](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/646)) • Remove the broken Refresh item from the gRPC method picker • Fix Postman import swapping the API key name and value ([#643](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/643)) • Join cURL line continuations followed by whitespace ([#644](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/644)) • Accept responses with more than 100 headers ([#658](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/658), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/when-response-headers-exceed-a-certain-count-hyper-throws-error)) • Focus the confirm button when a dialog opens • Use the current time when uuid.v6 has no timestamp ([#647](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/647)) • Stop flagging an empty JSON editor as invalid • Fix the MCP server ignoring environmentId on send_http_request ([#654](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/654)) • Flush exported files to disk before the CLI reports success ([#686](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/686))

Full changelog: https://yaak.app/changelog/2026.7.1
🛠️ Fixed
- Fix param edits from one request appearing on its duplicate when switching between them (#617, feedback)

Full changelog: https://yaak.app/changelog/2026.7.0
🎁 New
- 🔗 Import from a URL (#551)
- 🕘 Filter history with pinning (#338, feedback)
- 📄 GraphQL schemas from a file (#462)
- 📥 New OpenAPI importer (#486, feedback)
- Create an environment for each OpenAPI server URL (#590, feedback)
- Force HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 per request, folder, or workspace (#609, feedback)
💄 Improved
- 🔌 Plugin API for reading response bodies (#560)
- Show the CLI update notice in non-interactive shells so agents see it
- Support OpenAPI 3.2 QUERY and additional operations on import (#591)
- Fill OAuth client ID and secret from environment variables on OpenAPI import (#587, feedback)
- Import spec-level OpenAPI security as workspace authentication (#601)
- Generate XML bodies and serialize deepObject, label, and matrix parameters on OpenAPI import (#602)
- Fill the OAuth redirect URI from an environment variable on OpenAPI import (#610, feedback)
🛠️ Fixed
- Honor workspace connection settings in CLI sends (#537)
- Include the request body in AWS SigV4 signatures (#430, feedback)
- Fix OAuth password grant tokens being reused when the username changes (#426)
- Restore HTTP/2 and client certificate support when TLS validation is disabled (#543)
- Follow the OS appearance when set to System without opening a new window (#540, feedback)
- Fix a sync watcher crash when the sync directory path traverses a symlink (#541)
- Don't save the response when the file dialog is cancelled (feedback)
- Fix client certificates on Linux when TLS validation is disabled (#554)
- Upgrade dependencies to resolve 29 security advisories (#562)
- Don't send scope on the OAuth authorization code token request (#579, feedback)
- Fix new workspaces defaulting to not sending or storing cookies (#573)
- Fix Timeline entries appearing in reverse order (#573)
- Read combined short flags as separate options when importing cURL (#577)
- Render all columns in irregular CSV responses (#584)
- Fix the app not activating after a relaunch on macOS (#583)
- Quote apostrophes and file paths when copying as cURL or gRPCurl (#593)
- Keep --data-urlencode values whole and tolerate a stray % on cURL import (#597)
- Preserve OpenAPI security requirement semantics on import (#586)
- Fix OpenAPI import of array $refs, cookie parameters, mid-segment path templates, and typed examples (#599)
- Preserve the base URL variable when an OpenAPI document omits servers (#585, feedback)
- Prevent the environment dropdown from opening alongside the environment editor
- Fix the System appearance always resolving to light on macOS 27 (#603)
- Send the signing key as the OAuth 1.0 PLAINTEXT signature (#605)
- Keep an = inside --url-query and form values on cURL import (#606)
- Escape control characters in the json.escape template function (#607)
- Render template values before plugin config forms use them, fixing the 1Password vault dropdown (#608)
- Check for updates on Linux deb, rpm, and Flatpak installs and say how to update (#604, feedback)
- Sign OAuth 1.0 requests with the token secret when no access token is set (#611)
